Scope of Driving Licence B

A passenger car driving licence permits you to drive a passenger car, and also to tow a trailer with that car. However, maximum weight limits do apply.

Empty trailer weight

Weight of the trailer as delivered by the manufacturer (so this may include any spare wheels and tools that accompany the trailer, but not all extra accessories).

Maximum authorised mass (trailer)

Maximum total weight of the trailer including load — that is the unladen weight plus the permissible payload. To determine whether you can legally tow a trailer, always check the maximum authorised mass (toegestane maximummassa) rather than the unladen weight.

✅
Trailer ≤ 750 kg → Licence B only
If the trailer's maximum authorised mass is 750 kg or less, a B licence is sufficient — even if the combined total exceeds 3500 kg.
⚠️
Trailer > 750 kg + combination ≤ 3500 kg → Licence B only
If the trailer exceeds 750 kg but the combined maximum authorised mass does not exceed 3500 kg, a B licence is still sufficient.
🚫
Trailer > 750 kg + combination > 3500 kg → Licence B + E required
If both conditions are met — the trailer exceeds 750 kg and the combination exceeds 3500 kg — you must have both a B and an E licence.

Trailers up to 750 kg

To tow a trailer with a maximum authorised mass of 750 kg or less with a passenger car, only a B driving licence is required, even if the maximum authorised mass of the car and trailer combined exceeds 3500 kg.

Trailers Heavier than 750 kg

Trailers with a maximum authorised mass above 750 kg may in some cases be towed with a passenger car using only a B driving licence. In this case, the maximum authorised mass of the combination must not exceed 3500 kg.

Heavier Vehicle Combinations

If the maximum authorised mass of the combination does exceed 3500 kg and the trailer weighs more than 750 kg, a B driving licence is no longer sufficient. To drive this combination, you must have an E driving licence (as well as a B licence). This licence permits you to tow trailers with a maximum authorised mass up to 3500 kg with a passenger car.

Examples

Which driving licence is required usually depends on the combined weight of both vehicles.

✅ Licence B only

In this combination, the maximum authorised mass of the caravan — less than 750 kg — is the key factor. This combination requires only a B driving licence. The maximum authorised mass of the passenger car is less important here, as long as it does not exceed 3500 kg.

✅ Licence B only

The combined maximum authorised masses is important in this combination. The trailer is heavier than 750 kg. However, the combination is lighter than 3500 kg (namely 2900 kg) and can therefore still be driven with driving licence B.

🚫 Licence B + E required

With this combination, the trailer is heavier than 750 kg. In addition, the combination together is heavier than 3500 kg (namely 3850 kg). Therefore, driving licence B is not enough — you also need the trailer driving licence E for this combination.
